notes.title: The Games Advent Calendar 2024 announcement!
notes.content:
After the success of the Games Advent Calendar last year, we are proud to announce the [b]Games Advent Calendar 2024![/b] ☃️

Jump on a train packed with gifts and dive into the holiday spirit! 🚂 Travel by train through a magical winter wonderland. ❄️Your journey is 25 magical days from the first of December till Christmas. Go for the ultimate Advent Calendar experience by unlocking a new day every day, or just immediately unlock all the games if you can’t wait! 🎁

Experience some fan-favorite returning game concepts in a new setting or enjoy many new ones. From Bobsleigh Relay, Polar Cross, Snowdrift Racers, to Frostbreaker and many more. Play with up to 8 players by passing on the controller and see who will top the leaderboard. 🏔️

Games Advent Calendar 2024 is the perfect holiday treat, offering endless fun! 🌲 September 26th the game will be available digitally on PC Steam, Xbox Series S|X, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch. Also coming to stores physically on PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch. 🛒

Visit our [b]new store page[/b] below and [b]wishlist now[/b] to stay up to date with our holiday adventure!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2796390/Games_Advent_Calendar_2024/

notes.title: Merry Christmas and happy holidays!
notes.content:
Christmas time is finally here! All of the doors have been unlocked and we hope you’ve enjoyed the wait leading up to the most wonderful time of the year! Which game was your favorite? If you haven’t played them all yet, don’t worry – you can play and replay each game all year long.

We wish everyone a very merry Christmas, and a happy 2024. Until next year!

notes.title: Christmas is getting close but there are a few doors left op open.
notes.content:
It's almost Christmas but there are a few days left on the Games Advent Calendar...

On this 22nd day of December, open a new day on the calendar and play Bauble Shooter. Play against friends and family to see who will win!

notes.title: Endless run = endless fun! Discover the new game today!
notes.content:
The advent season is in full swing! Quite a few games have already been revealed, but there is much more to come. Have you checked in every day to find which new games have unlocked? 

Today, you can play Vertical Endless Run, it is sure to be full of Christmas entertainment. What new game will unlock tomorrow? Only time will tell!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548337/aed150244bd578d561c5308abc72922713a33734.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Did you already open today's door on the Games Advent Calendar?
notes.content:
A few days have passed, and a few games have already unlocked. Still, there is so much more to come! Hang in there and remember to check back every day for a new game! 

Today we’ll find out what’s hiding behind door number 9 – Gift Runner! Get as far as you can across town and try to collect the gifts! Can you beat your own top score?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548337/aed150244bd578d561c5308abc72922713a33734.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The advent experience starts today!
notes.content:
The wait is over! Starting today, the advent season has officially kicked off, and for the next 24 days, a new game will unlock every day! For the full advent experience, check in every day to find what new game has unlocked. Have fun! 
 
Today, embark on an epic journey in Arctic Adventure. Jump your way from platform to platform as an adorable polar bear and avoid the obstacles on your way while collecting all the presents. What new game will unlock tomorrow? Only time will tell! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44548337/81731d7cf004dd42ad1d5c311016acea139df314.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Christmas Came Early This Year!
notes.content:
Prepare your wishlists, decorate your tree and celebrate Christmas now!

In GAMES ADVENT CALENDAR, immerse yourself in that fantastic Christmas spirit, an exciting new game, every day for 25 days!

Every morning when you wake up you can open a new festive gaming surprise. Can’t wait? No problem! Just like the little chocolates in a real Advent Calendar, you can open everything right away! ːsteamhappyː

Put your Christmas jumper on and pick out your favorite pair of socks, because you get to play Gift Runner, Arctic Adventure, Bauble Shooter, Penguin Runner, Holiday Jigsaw, TetriX-mas, Winterpong, Christmas Match 3, and many more surprises in Games Advent Calendar! - Ohh, and don't forget to bring a cup of hot chocolate with you! ;)
